messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Elevated 5xx rate detected for tenant valianthealth (VPC-us-west-2). Error rate > 8% over 3m, latency p95 up 2.3x. Paging oncall.
Alice H: oncall here. pulling logs now, linking runbook: https://intra.redwood/runbooks/vpc-tenant-degradation
Ben S: I'm with Val now on the Zoom. They report increased failures on their webhook callback path. Impacting 3 downstream services.
Alice H: ok, scoping. looks like model inference returns 502 from runtime shard pool rdp-13. Logs show: `GPU OOM` followed by `kv-cache miss flood` and retry storms. sample log:
```
2026-03-15T02:12:43Z rdp-13 infer ERROR model=instruct-xl_v2_2026 code=OOM tokens=512
2026-03-15T02:12:44Z rdp-13 router WARN retry=3 tenant=valianthealth route=private-vpc
```
Carol M: I'm here. rdp-13 is in Dedicated VPC pool for ValiantHealth? confirmed — they have reserved GPUs on that host group. looks like a memory regression in the most recent model variant we shipped as safe-variant-2026-03.
ValiantHealth-SRE: Confirmed, our front-ends show 502s starting ~02:10 UTC. Traffic is steady. We need a quick mitigation; can you swap to our previous pinned model (v1.9.7) or a low-memory variant? We prefer pin to v1.9.7.
Dave R: FYI account asked for pin as immediate step. They have VIP support tier so we should follow their escalation path.
Alice H: Options: 1) route tenant to `v1.9.7` (previous stable) — requires a quick config update on control plane, no infra change. 2) route to `safe-embed-small` low-memory variant — faster but may degrade outputs. 3) drain rdp-13 and reprovision — takes longer.
Ben S: Val prefers option 1, want fidelity preserved. are there compatibility concerns between pinned v1.9.7 and current runtime? last compatibility matrix shows supported but with quantization gap.
Carol M: v1.9.7 is compatible; runtime will pick fallback kernels. small perf hit expected but should avoid OOM. I'll prepare the rollout plan. propose canary 5% -> 50% -> 100% over 6 minutes with auto-rollback on 5xx>2%.
incident-bot: Action required: `patch route` for tenant valianthealth. Command suggestion:
```
redwood route update --tenant valianthealth --model v1.9.7 --canary 0.05 --slo 0.02
```
Alice H: executing canary now. patch done (change-id: ch_8921). Monitoring.
(1m)
Alice H: telemetry: canary at 5% shows 5xx down to 1.1%, latency p95 back to 1.1x baseline. no OOM logs yet on rdp-13 for v1.9.7.
ValiantHealth-SRE: seeing errors dropping in our dashboards. thank you.
Carol M: Ok meaningfully improved. I'll stay on the thread to monitor kernel selection logs. Also we should avoid full model pin unless customer signs off — side effects: slightly higher token cost, potential regression tests.
Dave R: I'll confirm with the customer if they want full 100% pin now that canary is healthy.
ValiantHealth-SRE: Please proceed to 100% pin for now. We want stable responses until your post-incident review.
Alice H: rolling to 100% now with 3-min ramp. (cmd patch id ch_8921 -> rollout)
(3m)
incident-bot: Update: rollout complete. 5xx for tenant valianthealth at 0.3% over 5m, p95 latency ~1.05x baseline. Closed pager for oncall. Recommended follow-ups: postmortem owner, root-cause triage, model regression revert checklist.
Ben S: I'll own postmortem with Carol. tagging docs and evals: need prompt set AB test between v1.9.7 and safe-variant-2026-03. Also want to schedule dedicated runtime repro for rdp-13 memory profile.
Carol M: noted. initial hypothesis: recent attention cache growth + different kv sharding in safe-variant caused memory pressure. we'll run memory repro on a replica and consider a smaller kv shard or flush policy.
Dave R: I'll update account and schedule a sync with Val leadership in 2 hours. Thanks team.
Alice H: Oncall handoff: I'll keep this in my queue for 30m then hand to night-oncall @Eve N. Postmortem start: Ben + Carol. Incident severity: Sev2 -> adjust if needed.
ValiantHealth-SRE: Appreciate the quick help. We'll await postmortem and want a formal SLA credit assessment if needed.
Carol M: Acknowledged. attaching runbook steps we followed:
- canary route to v1.9.7
- monitor 5xx and p95
- escalate to eng-runtime if OOM persists
- backlog: memory repro + model evals
Alice H: closing thread for active paging. will re-open if metrics regress. :white_check_mark:
